content.comment_body: Hello, I'm working with [product_name] ([version_no]) and trying to program it through [product_name]. I followed the configuration process shown in the [product_name] video tutorial, but unfortunately, it hasn't been successful. In [product_name], I can see that the connection to [product_name] is established, and I can access the web server feature, so the setup seems correct. The main issue is that when attempting to download or upload a program, or when performing an online test, the connection can't be established. I set the Ethernet and Virtualbox TAP Adapter, but clicking 'refresh' doesn't reveal my [product_name] device. Setting the IP manually and testing results in 'Remote device is non accessible.' Any suggestions? My device agent configuration [snip] EDIT: I fixed the issue. For anyone facing a similar problem, set 'GENERIC' and 'Layer2' instead of '[company_name] Ethernet.' This topic can be considered resolved.
Hi I'm unable to get mine working. Could you share an image of your settings? Br [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered challenges connecting to [product_name] ([version_no]) using a remote access solution for programming and online testing. Although basic connectivity and web server access worked, download/upload and online test features reported the device as inaccessible due to network configuration issues. The problem was solved by switching the network settings from '[company_name] Ethernet' to 'GENERIC' and 'Layer2', highlighting the importance of appropriate configuration. Another user also faced similar difficulties and requested more details about the solution.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable remote programming and online testing of their [product_name] devices via remote access, as per tutorial instructions. They anticipate standard connectivity and easy device discovery or successful manual connection.
